jcr:title: Corporate governance
jcr:description:
At Stryker we are committed to doing what’s right. Good corporate governance is essential. We conduct our affairs in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations and in accordance with the highest ethical standards.

At the forefront of our organization is a winning team that measures the success of the Company not only by financial growth, but by how well we meet our own high standards of accountability. Our Board of Directors is elected annually and consists entirely of independent directors (with the exception of our Chair and CEO, Kevin Lobo). Together, the Board of Directors combines education, experience and a rich history of commitment to Stryker in making decisions that benefit our Company, our shareholders, and ultimately, the lives of the patients we serve.

largeheadline.line2: At Stryker, we are committed to doing what’s right and upholding our company values.

text.text:
Good corporate governance is essential, and we strive to conduct our affairs in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations and in accordance with the highest ethical standards. Our policies and guidelines provide transparency and clarity for our employees and stakeholders.

At the forefront of our organization is a winning team that measures the success of the Company not only by financial growth, but by how well we meet our own high standards of accountability. Our Board of Directors is elected annually and consists entirely of independent directors (with the exception of our Chair and CEO, Kevin Lobo). Together, the Board of Directors combines education, experience and a rich history of commitment to Stryker in making decisions that benefit our Company, our shareholders, and ultimately, the lives of the patients we serve.

text.text: Stryker is committed to the highest standards of ethical and lawful conduct. Our policies and procedures are a critical part of that commitment and apply to all employees of Stryker, except where noted otherwise. You can view our corporate policies in your language.
